```{ojs}
//| label: playground-ui

d3 = require("d3@7")

// ── Layout shell ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layout = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "playground-layout";

  // ── SIDEBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sidebar = document.createElement("div");
  sidebar.id = "sidebar";

  // Legend section
  const legendSection = document.createElement("div");
  legendSection.innerHTML = `
    <p class="sidebar-section-title">Legend</p>
    <div class="legend-card">
      <div class="legend-grid">
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#d62728"/></svg> Male Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#1f77b4"/></svg> Male Positive
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#d62728" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#1f77b4" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Positive
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Bias Configuration section
  const biasSection = document.createElement("div");
  biasSection.innerHTML = `<p class="sidebar-section-title">Bias Configuration</p>`;
  const biasCard = document.createElement("div");
  biasCard.className = "controls-card";
  biasCard.append(viewof_bias_type, viewof_bias_amount);
  biasSection.append(biasCard);

  // Controls section
  const controlsSection = document.createElement("div");
  const controlsTitle = document.createElement("p");
  controlsTitle.className = "sidebar-section-title";
  controlsTitle.textContent = "Base Parameters";

  const controlsCard = document.createElement("div");
  controlsCard.className = "controls-card";
  const makeGroupDetails = (title, formElement) => {
    const d = document.createElement("details");
    d.style.marginBottom = "0.5rem";
    d.innerHTML = `<summary class="sidebar-section-title" style="cursor:pointer; padding-top:0.25rem;">${title}</summary>`;
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    wrapper.style.padding = "0.25rem 0 0 0.25rem";
    wrapper.append(formElement);
    d.append(wrapper);
    return d;
  };

  controlsCard.append(
    viewof_total_samples,
    document.createElement("hr"),
    makeGroupDetails("Male Positive", viewof_params_mp),
    makeGroupDetails("Male Negative", viewof_params_mn),
    makeGroupDetails("Female Positive", viewof_params_fp),
    makeGroupDetails("Female Negative", viewof_params_fn)
  );

  controlsSection.append(controlsTitle, controlsCard);
  sidebar.append(legendSection, biasSection, controlsSection);

  // ── Main right area: results on top, charts below ─────────────────────────
  const chartAndResults = document.createElement("div");
  chartAndResults.id = "chart-and-results";

  // ── Export panel at TOP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const resultsPanel = document.createElement("div");
  resultsPanel.id = "results-panel";
  resultsPanel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="results-header" style="border-bottom:none; margin-bottom:0;">
      <div class="results-title-container">
        <p class="results-title">Dataset Export</p>
        <p class="results-subtitle">Generate CSV with Train, Validation, and Test splits</p>
      </div>
      <div class="results-actions" id="results-actions"></div>
    </div>
  `;
  resultsPanel.classList.add("visible");

  const downloadBtn = document.createElement("button");
  downloadBtn.className = "train-btn";
  downloadBtn.id = "download-btn";
  downloadBtn.innerHTML = `<span class="btn-spinner"></span> <span id="download-btn-label">Download CSV</span>`;
  downloadBtn.addEventListener("click", () => window._downloadCSV && window._downloadCSV());

  const resultsActions = resultsPanel.querySelector("#results-actions");
  resultsActions.append(downloadBtn);

  // ── Two charts side by side ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const chartsRow = document.createElement("div");
  chartsRow.id = "charts-row";

  // Training chart
  const chartArea = document.createElement("div");
  chartArea.id = "chart-area";
  const chartHeader = document.createElement("div");
  chartHeader.className = "chart-header";
  chartHeader.innerHTML = `<p class="chart-title">Training Set</p><p class="chart-subtitle">Adjust parameters to explore group dynamics</p>`;
  const chartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  chartContainer.className = "chart-container"; chartContainer.id = "chart-container";
  chartArea.append(chartHeader, chartContainer);

  chartsRow.append(chartArea);
  chartAndResults.append(resultsPanel, chartsRow);
  root.append(sidebar, chartAndResults);
  return root;
}

viewof_bias_type = Inputs.select(["None", "Base-rate difference", "Feature predictivity", "Proxies", "Task-difficulty difference", "Label bias"], {value: "None", label: "Bias Preset"})
viewof_bias_amount = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.05, label: "Amount of Bias"})

viewof_total_samples  = Inputs.range([100, 2000], {value: 500,  step: 50,   label: "Total Samples"})

makeParamsForm = (defX, defY, defW) => Inputs.form({
  mean_x: Inputs.range([-5, 15], {value: defX, step: 0.1, label: "Mean X"}),
  mean_y: Inputs.range([-5, 15], {value: defY, step: 0.1, label: "Mean Y"}),
  std_x:  Inputs.range([0.1, 5], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Std Dev X"}),
  std_y:  Inputs.range([0.1, 5], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Std Dev Y"}),
  weight: Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: defW, step: 0.1, label: "Weight"})
});

viewof_params_mp = makeParamsForm(0, 3, 1)
viewof_params_mn = makeParamsForm(0, 0, 1)
viewof_params_fp = makeParamsForm(3, 3, 1)
viewof_params_fn = makeParamsForm(3, 0, 1)

bias_type         = Generators.input(viewof_bias_type)
bias_amount       = Generators.input(viewof_bias_amount)
total_samples     = Generators.input(viewof_total_samples)
params_mp         = Generators.input(viewof_params_mp)
params_mn         = Generators.input(viewof_params_mn)
params_fp         = Generators.input(viewof_params_fp)
params_fn         = Generators.input(viewof_params_fn)
```
